The '''kingdom of Devit''' was a [[King/Legends|kingdom]] established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]]. During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the kingdom was rule by King [[Alarik X]]. It was composed of three continents, [[Torm]], [[Elgar]] and [[Laz]], and its [[Capital/Legends|capital]] was [[Lazeria City]].
